description: Report that a catalog server works, is broken or is unsafe, backed by a signed decision record (Cedulon format) from your gate. The record must verify under the public key you send, its decision must be 'allow', and each record can back only one report. Unsigned opinions are not accepted here.

operatorKeyPem.description: PEM public key of the gate that signed the record

name: submit_report
title: File a signed proof report
